spec.claim_summary: Buy ETH/USDT on the 4-hour chart when the green Ichimoku lead line is above the red lead line and price closes above the green line, exiting when price closes below the green line.
spec.untestable_reason: The strategy's entry and exit depend entirely on Ichimoku lead lines which are not in the available indicator set and have no allowed substitute.

claimed.other: you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin

assumptions: Assets interpreted as ETHUSDT spot from 'crypto pair ETH/USDT'.
Timeframe interpreted as 4h from 'four hour chart'.
Direction interpreted as long: bullish cloud plus close above green line to enter and close below green line to exit implies a long position.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Ichimoku Senkou Span lead lines (green/red) are not in the available indicator set; the filter 'green above red', the entry 'closed above the green lead line' and the exit 'close below the green lead line' cannot be encoded and were omitted.
Period start 2017-01-01 interprets 'beginning of 2017'; period end 2021-06-02 interprets 'today' as the posting date.
Source type mapped to text because tradingview_script is not an allowed value.

evidence.quote: you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin
